name: Carla Gallo
bio: Carla Paolina Gallo (born 24 June 1975) is an American actress. Gallo has had recurring roles in the television series Undeclared, Carnivàle, Bones, Californication, and a number of film roles. Since her role on Undeclared, she has made frequent appearances in other Judd Apatow productions.
place: Brooklyn, New York City, New York, USA
